title: Higgsfield AI
description: Generate AI images, videos, texture blocks, photos, and prompt-built structures directly inside Minecraft.
body:
![higgsfield](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0291437cdbb873ccc1d562d33eaa13bdb327db9.png)
Higgscraft brings AI generation tools into Minecraft.

Use the Supercomputer to generate images, print them onto maps, create generated paintings and texture blocks, capture in-game photos with a camera, generate Film Rolls for video playback, and use the Architect's Wand to create structures from text prompts.

Features:
- AI image generation inside Minecraft
- Generated paintings, maps, and texture blocks
- Camera item for taking in-game photos
- Film Roll and video screen/projector blocks
- Redstone-triggered AI Generator block
- Architect's Wand for prompt-based structure generation
- Generation Archive for browsing recent AI outputs

Requirements:
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.233 or newer
- Higgsfield sign-in for image/video generation
- OpenRouter API key for AI-designed structures
